# Repository instructions

Before editing AI Design Canvas, read and follow:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/VISION.md`
- `docs/PRODUCT_SPEC.md`
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `docs/ROADMAP.md`

The repository is building an open-source AI-native design operating system, not merely a prompt-to-HTML generator. Preserve the separation between portable `DESIGN.md`, the structured editable design document, production code, and their explicit mappings. Prefer typed/reversible project operations and real working features over UI-only simulations.
